turnDetection.silenceBehavior: Use skip_turn without text or audio while waiting for new customer input.

skip_turn.name: skip_turn
skip_turn.description: Wait silently when there is no new customer message after a greeting, question, or completed response, including silence timeouts. Also use when the customer requests a pause. Do not speak or send any text before or after this tool. Resume normally for a new customer message or a pending tool result needed to answer it.
